summary: The round 3 fixes do what was decided. `textParts` now escapes a text whole only for a backslash directly before a backtick (`/\]\(|\]\[|:\/\/|www\.|[\r\n]|\\`/i`). Traced by hand, since the reviewer cannot run node: the namespaced case gives exactly the line pinned for app/n.vue:14. Its spans `<x-slot>`, `@csrf` and `$a && $b` are left as written, while `\<b>` and `\&` are escaped outside them. Case 6 (`\`` before `<i>`) is still escaped whole. Escaping adds no backslash, backtick or trigger, so `readBack` still cuts the posted text into the same parts and the new round-trip mode holds. The README and `docs/running.md` costs, the R3-1 inline-link line and the R3-2 Deferred-line pin introduce no correctness bug. The earlier round titles posted on this PR hold no backslash, so changing the trigger cannot change how one of them reads back.
